claims: In FUN_00128ca0, the packet stream writes command word 0x6c080000, appends eight 16-byte values (four loaded from caller address s0+0..s0+0x30 and four loaded from addresses 0x70003160..0x7000319c), and then appends the command derived from 0x14000000 | *(gp-0x6dec).
The command 0x6c080000 encodes UNPACK V4-32, NUM=8, destination address 0 according to pinned PS2SDK field definitions.
The VU entry at byte address 0x2e60 begins by loading qwords at VU addresses 0 through 7 into VF01 through VF08, then executes XTOP VI01 and uses TOP-relative loads.

FUN_00128e88 chooses geometry UNPACK base 0x208 or 0x2c8, emits V3-16 at that base and V4-8 at base+1, and leaves UNPACK immediate bit 15 clear; those commands therefore do not themselves add TOPS to their destination addresses.

At 0x2e60's entry path, LOI raw words 0x44400000 and 0x45c00000 load I before SUBI.xyz on VF15 and SUBI.xy on VF12 respectively; this proves those exact subtract constants but does not establish a serialized-coordinate scale.

The bounded 0x2e60 path has FTOI4.xyz VF16,VF17 after the Q multiply path, and the Sony VU User's Manual defines FTOI4 as conversion with four fractional bits; this is a fixed-point conversion fact, not a proof of output units or hardware execution.

XTOP reads the external VIF TOP register into the integer register, but the local FUN_00128ca0 block does not set BASE or OFFSET before MSCAL 0x5cc, so these local sources alone do not bind TOP to geometry UNPACK base 0x208 or 0x2c8.

evidence.text: Static export executable SHA256 216711210898aee296eed73d0776e7f733bac04c334002683bce769c86beea95. FUN_00128ca0 instructions: 00128cec lui t2,0x6c08; 00128d3c sw t2,0(v0); then stores qwords from lq 0(s0)/sq at 00128d50, lq 0x10(s0)/sq 00128d60-68, lq 0x20(s0)/sq 00128d78-80, lq 0x30(s0)/sq 00128d90-9c, followed by lq from 0x70003160, 3164, 3168, 316c; 3170,3174,3178,317c; 3180..318c; 3190..319c, each sq into packet buffer at 00128db0, 00128dc8, 00128de0, 00128df8. At 00128e08 lw v0,-0x6dec(gp); 00128e10 or v0,v0,t3 (t3 initialized by 00128d0c lui t3,0x1400); 00128e14 sw v0,0(v1). The command/data ordering is static output construction, not proof the DMA ran.

Pinned PS2SDK commit ac92a9f657d2e531dd8f060250b07f2a5ac6dea5. common/include/vif_codes.h SHA256 b28a4d58edf1245c54fd7bfa8276b9d59ae5a369a27db57ba09938b5f8c4adfb defines VIF command fields: immediate bits 0-15, NUM bits 16-23, command bits 24-31; packet2_types.h enum P2_UNPACK_V4_32=0x0c. A command byte 0x6c is UNPACK family base 0x60 plus 0x0c, with NUM=8 and IMMEDIATE=0.

Overlay 5 disassembly SHA256 f5e195d23ec624026e31caae2c31d7af6cce10ec36158632f8624eeb640499d5, binary SHA256 4d9dfc5c917746997f2bf4bd95068deca7fce6c3b447dc591fa74f537798ef0c. At pair204/address 0x2e60: iaddiu vi01,vi00,0. Pairs205..212 / addresses 0x2e68..0x2ea0: lqi vf01..vf08,(vi01++), eight sequential qword loads. Pair215/address0x2eb8: xtop vi01. Later pair219: lq vf31,2(vi01); pair220/221: ilw from 3(vi01); pair223/224/226: lq vf09,0(vi01), vf30,1(vi01), vf20,4(vi01). Pair230 contains LOI payload bytes 00 00 40 44 => little-endian raw 0x44400000. Pair231 SUBI.xyz vf15,vf15,I; pair232 MUL.xyz vf15,vf15,vf20; pair234 LOI raw 0x45c00000; pair235 SUBI.xy vf12,vf12,I. Pair246..249 transform vf16 into vf17. Pair250 DIV Q using vf00.w/vf17.w; pair253 WAITQ; pair254 MULQ.xyz vf17,vf17,Q. Overlay6 pair0/address0x3000 FTOI4.xyz vf16,vf17. Overlay6 pairs2..4 store vf12, vf30, vf16 with SQI. Addresses/pairs and raw LOI words were independently inspected.

Existing notes/evidence/fr2-geometry-vif-contract/README.md and source-provenance.json. FUN_00128e88 encodes base = 0x208 when saved selector zero, otherwise 0x2c8; V3-16 command at base and V4-8 at base+1. The immediate's bits 14 and 15 are clear, so command does not request signedness bit or TOPS-adjusted address. It also appends optional V2-16 at base+2 only when saved param4!=0. These findings identify packet fields, not semantic meaning of VU memory contents.

Sony VU User's Manual v6.0, PDF mirror URL https://docs.alexrp.com/mips/ee_vu.pdf, pages 77-78: FTOI4 converts VF source to fixed point with four fractional bits; examples include 0.45 -> 7, 0.55 -> 8, 123.45 -> 1975, consistent with multiply by 16 and truncate toward zero. Page 197 describes XTOP as reading the VIF TOP register into VI[it]. This is instruction specification only.

FUN_00128ca0's local instruction excerpt has the V4-32 UNPACK command/data and MSCAL 0x5cc but no BASE/OFFSET command before MSCAL. FUN_00128e88 later emits a BASE command selected between 0x388/0x3aa and then OFFSET=0 after its later MSCNT command. Thus the writer does affect subsequent VIF state, but it does not set the TOP value consumed by the earlier MSCAL in FUN_00128ca0. Current TOP for that MSCAL depends on VIF state produced elsewhere / prior stream history; absent that full state trace, no link from geometry base to TOP-relative loads is proven.
